title: DTI-ALPS and WMH genetic relationship: analysis code and reproducibility materials
description: Reproducibility release accompanying the manuscript on genome-wide and chromosome 16 regional genetic relationships between DTI-ALPS phenotypes and white matter hyperintensity burden. This release includes analysis code, frozen regional inputs, derived results, figure source data, publication figures, environment metadata, and integrity checksums. Third-party source data remain subject to their original access and licensing terms.
